messages:
matt: heads-up — hit a nasty edge with python sdk retries.  Saw a 503 during a streaming create, sdk retried but body was already consumed, server ended up creating the object twice. repro below.

anna: ouch. can you paste the minimal repro and sdk version?

matt: using `redwood-python==0.8.2` (async client). repro:
```py
async def send():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY) as c:
        # streaming generator body
        async def gen():
            yield b'{"chunk":1}'
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
            yield b'{"chunk":2}'
        await c.create_resource(stream=gen())
```
server injected a 503 between chunks, sdk retried automatically and replay failed because generator was exhausted. result: create_resource ran twice on server (no idempotency header provided by app).

sasha: I think this is the backoff/windowing logic + replayability mismatch. SDK assumes a replayable request when it sees transient 5xx; but streaming bodies/generators aren't rewindable. We should not auto-replay in that case. Two fixes: require user-supplied idempotency token header for non-replayable bodies OR buffer small streaming bodies up to N bytes to allow replay.

matt: agree. current behaviour is: on transient 5xx we call _retry_request which clones request body. clone fails silently for async generators and we end up sending a new request that triggers creation again.

anna: can we detect generator/non-seekable body and fall back to "no automatic replay" + emit warning? That keeps current safe default and nudges users.

sasha: yes — implement check: if not hasattr(body, 'seek') and not isinstance(body, (bytes, bytearray, str, io.BytesIO)) then mark as non-replayable. Also add opt-in `allow_buffering=True, buffer_limit=64*1024` to buffer small bodies for replay. For streaming users, recommend providing `Idempotency-Key` header.

matt: plus edge: if server returns 5xx after we started accepting response chunks (partial success) we should treat as non-idempotent by default — do not replay. That will avoid duplicates for partial acknowledgements.

anna: filing an issue + design doc. put the triage label and set priority P2. also add an integration test that uses async generator and simulated transient 503 mid-stream.

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3421 — "py-sdk: avoid unsafe replay for non-rewindable bodies + buffering opt-in". Labels: devex, retry, idempotency, p2.

matt: i'll pick this up tomorrow. plan: add detection + unit tests, then a small doc section in async streaming guide showing recommended idempotency header usage.

sasha: SGTM. also add telemetry metric `sdk.retry.non_replayable_detected` so we can see how often apps rely on buffering.

anna: thanks — assigning to @matt. :thumbsup:

matt: thanks — will send draft PR and tag for review.
